rows.grounds: numeral element forming the count eighty-four thousand
locative plural indicating the total number
past passive participle describing those afflicted

items.question: What condition afflicts beings within the eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms?
premises: The scope is eighty-four thousand in number.
These are womb-mechanisms serving as loci of existence.
Beings within them are described as tormented.
items.inference: Beings situated in the eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms exist in a state of torment.
uncertainties: The subject experiencing torment is implied from context rather than explicitly named in this verse.
items.plain_english: They are tormented within the eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms.
